description: 10-component loss weights for CondorNet v4.3. Loaded by condor_train_net_v43.py at startup.

annealing.note: Weights ramp linearly from initial value to end_weight between start_epoch and end_epoch. All other weights remain constant.

component_notes.strategy_ce: Cross-entropy over 10 strategy classes (9 real + abstain). Constant weight — strategy selection is always critical.
component_notes.pop_bce: Binary cross-entropy for PoP calibration. Constant 1.0 — pop_bce plateaus early (~0.613), annealing above 1.0 just inflates val loss and biases best-epoch selection.
component_notes.ev_mse: MSE for Expected Value. Delayed ramp allows model to stabilize before EV supervision intensifies.
component_notes.risk_mse: MSE for VaR + CVaR + max_loss combined. Constant — risk boundary enforcement never relaxes.
component_notes.size_mse: MSE for fuzzy position size output (0-1). Constant.
component_notes.spot_mse: MSE for target spot price (auxiliary task). Low weight — serves as regularizer only.
component_notes.fuzzy_var: Variance penalty on fuzzy gate outputs. Decays to near-zero as model stabilizes.
component_notes.pattern_ent: Entropy regularizer on predicate pattern activations. Low constant weight.
component_notes.robust: Huber loss component for outlier robustness in EV/risk predictions.
component_notes.consensus_consistency: MTF consensus gate shaping: pushes entry_signal up when psar_trend+breakout_score agree across M1/M5/M15/H1. Ramps from 0.05 to 0.10 between epoch 5-25.
component_notes.exit_bce: Binary CE for SimExit head. Placeholder labels (0.0) produce near-constant loss until SimExit labeling engine populates real exit_signal targets. Weight 0.5 keeps it from dominating while scaffold is inactive.
